adapter: Functions V8; actual module sources plus minimal DOM and assert adapter

checks.name: each remaining route offers its own three observations
local topics retain geographic order while seeded replay timing changes
discovery is optional, bounded by progress, and never interrupts a story or photo
capture validates the current opportunity and is immutable and idempotent
journal storage keeps only known unique IDs and survives corrupt or denied storage
one observation click keeps walking and changes the journal and final memory
SVG observation can be collected with the keyboard while paused; animation stays frozen
three optional observations appear in the ending; replay resets the trip but retains the journal
missing an observation has no penalty; photos hide the alternative observation button
denied persistence still allows observations and clearly reports session-only storage
all nine checkpoint facts and journal topics belong to their own place and carry source links
three regional compositions remain finite and preserve the original reference geography
remembering a local topic shows a real regional photo and learning note while walking continues
checkpoint knowledge changes with the actual photograph and never advances photo dwell time
legacy journal IDs keep saved topics, with local photos available after a fresh page load
route-shaped cartoon map and backpack person remain; obsolete micromanagement controls are absent
one start click makes the hiker move over time without directional input
pause and background visibility cancel the clock and do not skip time on return
a story encounter stops automatically; only a story choice resumes walking
photo stops show a genuine local image and attribution; continuing resumes the journey
reopening a collected photograph preserves the prior walk/pause state
map overview is optional and does not advance time or unlock photographs
photo failure offers the verified source and recovers on the next postcard
full scenic trip has an ending and replay clears discoveries
changing route cancels old animation and resets narrative/photographs
each story route completes in the interface and keeps all photograph cards
aotai early ending is a complete narrative result and does not force the final postcard
limbs articulate while walking and stay planted when a photo or pause stops the clock
clouds and mist move with the journey clock and freeze during a stop
every named checkpoint renders its scenic icon both on the map and in the album
keyboard landmark activation opens the right collected photograph and preserves pause state
